description: Defines the QuicServerInfo interface for fetching and caching QUIC server information, including failure reasons, state management, and serialization methods.

classes.name: QuicServerInfo
classes.description: Interface for managing QUIC server info, including loading, persisting, and state management.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Fetches the server config from storage; returns true if successful.

methods.name: Persist
methods.description: Persists the current server info for future use.

methods.name: state
methods.description: Returns a const reference to the current state.

methods.name: mutable_state
methods.description: Returns a mutable pointer to the current state.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Parses pickled data to fill the object's fields; returns true if successful.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the object's state into a string.
